values.description: The past observations of one series, oldest first; null marks a missing observation. At most 8192, with at least one number, each inside the float32 range (about 3.4e38).

horizon.description: How many future steps to forecast, from 1 to 1024, decoded in one pass.

quantile_levels.description: Quantile levels to return, ascending and unique, each between 0 and 1. Levels between the 21 trained ones (0.01, 0.05 to 0.95 in steps of 0.05, 0.99) are interpolated; levels beyond them follow exponential tails. Defaults to the 21 trained levels. A level must not round to 0 or 1 in float32 (1e-7 to 0.9999999 is safe), and series x horizon x (levels + 1) must stay within 640,000 numbers.

covariates.description: Known-future covariates (calendar features, planned events, prices, weather forecasts): each series spans the past and the horizon, len(values) + horizon steps, null for missing. The model conditions on them but does not forecast them.

past_covariates.description: Other series observed over the same past steps as values (same length, null for missing). They attend to the target and are forecast jointly with it; their forecasts come back in past_covariate_forecasts.

symmetric_averaging.description: Average the forecast with the mirrored forecast of the negated series (runs the model twice). Skipped for a series whose observed minimum is exactly zero. Default false.

clip_nonnegative.description: Clip the forecast at zero when the observed history is non-negative. Default false.

snap_integers.description: Round the forecast to integers when the observed history is integer-valued. Default false.
